academic.note: University coursework at Monash University Malaysia. Code and reports aren't published here, but I'm happy to walk through them on request.

items.title: Generative AI for Humanity
items.summary: Measured bias in two open-source unconditional image-generation models. Classified faces in the original and generated images with an open-source face-recognition model, then compared them using Cramér's V and Ducher's Z. Also covered testing, a step-by-step user guide and the project documentation.

items.title: COVID-19 Pro-Social Behaviour Study
items.summary: Used linear models to find the top predictors of pro-social behaviour during COVID-19 in a focus country, and compared them with other countries. Added external data (vaccination rate, GDP, development index) and clustered countries to test whether similar countries share the same predictors.

items.title: More Humid Tomorrow Prediction
items.summary: Predicted whether tomorrow will be more humid than today. Compared decision tree, naive Bayes, bagging, boosting, random forest, neural network and KNN classifiers by confusion matrix, ROC curve and AUC, then used variable importance to drop weak predictors and retest.

items.title: NLP for Network Analysis
items.summary: Built a corpus of three topics from 15 Google Scholar sources, cleaned and tokenised it into document-term matrices, and clustered the documents hierarchically, checking the clusters against topic labels. Mapped word and document relationships with single-mode and bipartite networks using degree, betweenness, closeness and eigenvector centrality.
